title: Adding a scene/route to a product: manifest plus generated files must change together
answers: How do I add a new page/scene to the workflows product?
Moved a route and URLs, what files need updating?
Where are broadcasts URLs and routes defined?
body:
Moving or adding a scene in products/workflows touches several places in the same PR:
- products/workflows/manifest.tsx: `scenes`, `routes`, `urls` (source of truth; also `fileSystemTypes`/tree `sceneKey`).
- frontend/src/scenes/sceneTypes.ts: `Scene` enum entry and `sceneToAccessControlResourceType` (Workflow resource for broadcast scenes).
- Auto-generated mirrors: frontend/src/productScenes.tsx, frontend/src/products.tsx (`productRoutes`, `productConfiguration`, `productUrls`, `sceneKeys` lists).
- services/mcp/src/tools/links/app-url-manifest.json and the snapshot services/mcp/tests/unit/__snapshots__/tool-schemas/generate-app-url.json (URL catalog listing).
If a scene key is added, also add it to `sceneKeys` of the related product tree items so the sidebar highlights correctly.
applies: products/workflows scenes and URLs (Workflows, Broadcasts, Broadcast)
